text_block_list.text: One night, while doing rounds on the course—

――A lone Umamusume runs in silence.
How long had she been out there?
I couldn't recall……

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...There's someone I want to catch up to.
That's why I'm... running too.
choice_data_list: Does that mean you have a goal?
Does that mean you have a goal?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...When I keep running, it's always nighttime.
So... I always run... about this much.
...Watching her leave the training course, a sudden realization struck me.
...I could've sworn there was an extra set of footsteps just now...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: She was running right in front of me, and that made me want to catch up... That's all there is to it.

It seemed she had a clear goal in mind.
That was surely why she had displayed such intense concentration.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...That should be enough, right? It looks like my friends are leaving, so I'll go too...

Right then――
something suddenly dawned on me.
...Just now, it sounded like there was one extra pair of footsteps...
